finding: Monitoring provenance v4 still trusted SUPERVISOR_INBOX alone for current provider authority. That was insufficient because supervisor 9.08 had already demonstrated a real split-control-plane failure mode where inbox epoch and canonical FREE_PROVIDER_ADMISSION epoch diverged. A monitoring publisher must not silently choose one side of such a split.

source_changes.change: Provider authority is now accepted as current only when SUPERVISOR_INBOX and FREE_PROVIDER_ADMISSION are both well formed, authority_epoch equals inbox schema_version, mode is FREE_ONLY, provider map booleans are valid, route-level admission agrees with the provider map, emergency stop cannot coexist with admitted providers, and Together remains forbidden. Any split fails closed.

Added fail-closed negatives for inbox/admission epoch split, route/provider-map split, emergency-stop/provider split, and Together-policy split while retaining live-/proc versus snapshot-separation tests.

next_exact_action: On a clean current non-provider checkout, execute tests/test_free_swarm_restart_authority_attribution_v3.py and tests/test_update_system_analysis_v4.py and bind HEAD/tree/source hashes/dirty=false/stdout/stderr. Only after both repository-bound test suites pass may restart-authority v3 be used read-only on the live Clay host and monitoring v4 be switched into the retained publisher. Do not advance the supervisor authority epoch merely for this source change; FREE_PROVIDER_ADMISSION and SUPERVISOR_INBOX must remain coherent.
